body:
When I first met Mystery, I stumbled clumsily from her catapult, reeking of ignorance and arrogance  the muddy boot trails of my expectations staining her spontaneity in the delusion of control.  I bled intoxication.  She erupted into being with a startling boldness  laughing wildly at my condition.  The oddest ends of imperfection and imbalances above stability personified down into her surprisingly human form, which hovered, shimmering with green light  emerald enough to seize in a fist.  This lure, Ive learned, resembles Her counter-pursuit; In my invocation, I open a two-way door, through which motives are met, subject, pulled and played.  I presented myself naked and vulnerable, with hopes of some under_side standing illuminant, but was snuffed out in the same vigorous urgency with which she appeared.  Cackling, she dissolved into the walls  now a newly dimensional plane  and shredded, left to right, zipping me into the interlocking teeth of my vision.  My head rolled along the room and was eventually pinned against my left shoulder as I suffocated, encapsulated by the peeling edges of everything outside myself.  As I died, strangled by her realm, I withheld resistance until my body fought for itself.  It let out a cry and thrust against her will, settling in reunion with mind, resurrected.
